title: Discovery request with bit-string leaning attribute query fields
purpose: Probe attribute-query handling with a compact confirmed-request style payload whose nested fields are chosen to be mutation-friendly for later bit-string and length interactions.
expected_behavior: Endpoint should parse or reject the request cleanly; subsequent mutational growth of the value-specifier area may help reach encoding and field-interaction logic related to issue-guided bit-string handling.
constraints_preserved: tpkt total-length field is consistent with the complete message
discovery path diversity via getvariableaccessattributes-style request
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe protocol-level analogue only; it does not embed the standalone fuzz-harness payload reported for issue 516.
